nodes.name: IndexMetadata.java
nodes.summary: Represents metadata for database index definitions, including column names, uniqueness constraints, and table association.

nodes.name: DefaultPluginPackage.java
nodes.summary: Default implementation of PluginPackage with getters/setters for plugin metadata like name, version, author, and module dependencies.

nodes.name: DependencyGraph.java
nodes.summary: Dependency resolution graph for plugins using topological sort to determine deployment order based on plugin dependencies.

nodes.name: HotDeployUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static utility providing access to the current HotDeployEvent via thread-local storage during hot deployment processing.

nodes.name: GlobalPluginDeployListenerProxy.java
nodes.summary: Proxy that delegates deploy/undeploy events to a global plugin deploy listener obtained from OSGi service registry.

nodes.name: HookHotDeployListener.java
nodes.summary: Master hook deployment listener processing portal properties, language properties, custom JSP dirs, servlet filters, Struts actions, model listeners, events, services, authenticators, and indexer post-processors from hook XML configurations.

nodes.name: ExtHotDeployListener.java
nodes.summary: Hot deploy listener for EXT plugins that manages classloader merging, resource injection, Spring config loading, and servlet/portlet context path registration.

nodes.name: AndroidPlatformUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility for detecting Android deployment environment and retrieving the Android context from servlet event parameters.

nodes.name: DefaultPluginPackageInfo.java
nodes.summary: Encapsulates plugin package info with core properties: name, module ID, module group ID, module version and deployment context.
